explanation: Each male fasts through the whole incubation, huddling with other males for warmth, while the female feeds at sea. She returns around the time the chick hatches.

claims.text: Male emperor penguins incubate the egg on their feet, under a fold of skin, through the Antarctic winter.
Wandering albatrosses, snowy owls and Arctic terns do not incubate eggs on their feet through the Antarctic winter.
Male emperor penguins fast throughout incubation and huddle together for warmth.
Female emperor penguins feed at sea during incubation and return around the time the chick hatches.
